name: 43942 · Powhatan Pt, OH
findings: ZIP 43942 (Powhatan Pt) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43942 (Powhatan Pt) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43942 (Powhatan Pt) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).
